module: Node "Teleport To Last Road" (category `repeat_instant`). Teleports the vehicle to the last valid road (`spawn.teleportToLastRoad`) and triggers the `onVehicleTeleportedToLastRoad(vehId)` hook. Input pins: `vehId`, `resetVehicle` (bool), `destinationPos` (vec3, optional: position to look toward, otherwise 15 m in front of the vehicle).

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.

work.desc: Computes the target position then calls `spawn.teleportToLastRoad` and the hook.
